current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers
DETERMINE whether L can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple
IF a valid partition exists THEN PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition

GENERATE all possible triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
SEARCH for a collection of 15 disjoint triples that together cover every element of L exactly once
IF such a collection is found THEN OUTPUT one complete example of the 15 triples
ELSE REPORT that no valid partition exists
